verdict.rationale: HelixDB ships an official CLI with documented commands (auth, workspace, project, database, cluster management) and a dedicated getting-started guide, plus a probe confirming the CLI docs page. The `helix chef` bootstrapper further supports AI-native workflows by scaffolding projects and setting up agent/MCP tooling automatically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community validation of the CLI itself (community commentary focuses mostly on the query language, not the CLI) and no evidence of version history/maturity signals like changelog entries.
